title: Instagram recovery challenges were insufficiently bound to accounts
summary: The cited researcher documents a USD 10,000 award for this finding.
root_cause: Recovery challenge state did not maintain sufficiently strict binding among account, device context, and verification secret. Review challenge ownership and uniqueness throughout the recovery lifecycle.
impact: Researcher reports a separate, lower-severity account-takeover finding, fixed before publication.
defensive_takeaways: Bind recovery attempts and verification state to the intended account.
Use atomic security counters and test concurrent state transitions locally.

reward.evidence_quote: Facebook and Instagram security team fixed the issue and rewarded me $10000 as a part of their bounty program.
reward.notes: Individual finding, distinct from the researcher’s other Instagram recovery report; exact award/payment dates are unknown.
